judge.description: Engine lookdev capture of the transmission milestone. Score two things: that the capture shows what this description lists, and that the TRANSMISSION look (clear tinted surfaces that refract and absorb the colours behind them, refraction bending what is seen through them, correct overlap order where translucent objects interpenetrate) matches the reference. The reference is a finished illustration and is NOT the target for the scene: the sparse arrangement of a few simple procedural objects, the absence of characters, buildings, snow fields, particles, depth of field, fog and other post effects are expected at this milestone and must not lower the score; nor must the plainer set (simple props, a flat striped backdrop, a plain gradient sky and simple sun-plus-sky lighting without extra fill lights), which belongs to later milestones. Shows: three clear pale-cyan ice blocks of increasing thickness (about 0.15 m, 0.4 m and 0.8 m from left to right) standing on a floor of saturated coloured tiles, with a striped backdrop and coloured objects behind them; the tiles, stripes and objects show through the blocks refracted and tinted cyan, the thickest block is clearly the deepest blue (thickness-dependent absorption) while the thinnest is almost clear; white cracks and small round bubbles sit inside the blocks, and their top faces catch the bright sky light
